letter.subject: Graduate Civil Engineer 2027 - Urban Development (Norwest)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer 2027 Urban Development role in Norwest listed on your SmartRecruiters careers board. The two-year graduate program with buddy mentoring and exposure across urban development projects is the structured consulting start I am seeking.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge engineer and field engineer on a community hall renovation and residential subdivision finishing works, coordinating crews, checking drawings and keeping progress records.

I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I can start from February 2027 and am open to discussing relocation to Norwest. My Bachelor was completed in 2019, so my most recent civil qualification is the February 2026 Advanced Diploma. I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
